PR #4058 (STORY-2768 S3a) round 1 rework is on the PR branch: head d9b377e67f5 (c3cc4ccc2f0 fixes, 010adc82a0c inventory rows, merge of integration 6f12ea71765). Ready for the delta review.

All seven findings addressed; per-finding notes are in the PR comment (https://github.com/joemooney/aida/pull/4058#issuecomment-6885223621).
Limit to weigh: finding 1 asked for a survey-level regression; the test is on the extracted held_elsewhere with a real Claim plus the plan, not through survey.

Checks at d9b377e67f5: make check-ci-fast 48 passed; dell1 aida-cli-lib --lib (land:: session_hygiene bug_1985 bug_1929 worktree_gc salvage session_reap inventory) 378 passed, 0 failed. aida-cli integration binaries for the land area are not run at this head yet; I run them on dell1 before any merge.

Also: #4038 verified approved at a073b9791a16, no hold; it merges cleanly on the local candidate and goes in after its dell1 check. BUG-2565 fix branch fix/bug-2565-coalesce-window is at 9817d745b13; PR and mail follow when its dell1 run and fast gate finish.
subject: PR #4058 S3a rework at d9b377e67f5: ready for delta review
